name: handoff
description: Copy-paste session handoff summaries for continuing work in a fresh session, or a clean completion summary for Jira, Slack or email, saved to the project's .claude/handoff/ folder. /handoff writes one; it offers one as the context nears the point where it compacts, and /handoff on writes one before an idle session's prompt cache expires.
